cases.question: Xem incident GitHub xr3myzj7ms51: những component được ghi nhận nào bị ảnh hưởng? Actions có liên quan không?
cases.expected: Chi tiết incident liệt kê Webhooks, Actions, Pages; Actions có liên quan. Status resolved.

result.answer:
Dựa trên dữ liệu chi tiết của incident **xr3myzj7ms51** từ GitHub (được ghi nhận tại thời điểm snapshot `2026-11-09T03:50:47.065020+00:00`), thông tin cụ thể như sau:

1. **Các component được ghi nhận bị ảnh hưởng:**
   - **Webhooks**
   - **Actions**
   - **Pages**
   *(Ngoài ra, phần nội dung cập nhật còn đề cập đến Code Scanning và Copilot coding agent cũng gặp tình trạng trễ trong cùng sự cố).*

2. **GitHub Actions có liên quan hay không:**
   - **Có.** GitHub Actions nằm trong danh sách các component bị ảnh hưởng trực tiếp của incident này. Theo phần cập nhật (update) của sự cố, GitHub Actions đã trải qua tình trạng chậm trễ trong các lần chạy workflow (workflow runs) và cập nhật trạng thái job (job status updates) bị trễ tới 25 phút.

*Nguồn: Dữ liệu từ GitHub Status API (Incident ID: `xr3myzj7ms51`), URL: https://stspg.io/pjgptg3cfc6n*

updates.body:
On November 4, 2026, between 15:49 UTC and 16:48 UTC, and again between 17:20 UTC and 17:55 UTC, GitHub Actions, Pages, Webhooks, Code Scanning, and Copilot coding agent experienced delays. During this time, Actions workflow runs and job status updates were delayed by up to 25 minutes. Pages deployments dropped to about 4% of normal volume, webhook deliveries dropped to about 58% of normal volume, and Code Scanning analyses and Copilot coding agent sessions were delayed. Delayed events were processed after mitigation.

This incident was caused by a configuration change to an internal event-routing service that unexpectedly paused delivery of several event streams. The change depended on feature flags that were not set up as intended, which the service did not handle gracefully. We mitigated the first period by rolling back the configuration change at 16:14 UTC. The code change
The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
We are investigating reports of degraded performance for Actions and Pages

grade.reason: Trả lời hoàn toàn chính xác, đầy đủ dựa trên trace tool cung cấp và khớp với expected.

updates.body: Please refer to the combined summary in this related incident: https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/xr3myzj7ms51
The degradation affecting Actions has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
We are investigating reports of degraded availability for Actions

On November 4, 2026, between 15:49 UTC and 16:48 UTC, and again between 17:20 UTC and 17:55 UTC, GitHub Actions, Pages, Webhooks, Code Scanning, and Copilot coding agent experienced delays. During this time, Actions workflow runs and job status updates were delayed by up to 25 minutes. Pages deployments dropped to about 4% of normal volume, webhook deliveries dropped to about 58% of normal volume, and Code Scanning analyses and Copilot coding agent sessions were delayed. Delayed events were processed after mitigation.

This incident was caused by a configuration change to an internal event-routing service that unexpectedly paused delivery of several event streams. The change depended on feature flags that were not set up as intended, which the service did not handle gracefully. We mitigated the first period by rolling back the configuration change at 16:14 UTC. The code change

updates.body: Please refer to the combined summary in this related incident: https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/xr3myzj7ms51
The degradation affecting Actions has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.
We are investigating reports of degraded availability for Actions

On November 4, 2026, between 15:49 UTC and 16:48 UTC, and again between 17:20 UTC and 17:55 UTC, GitHub Actions, Pages, Webhooks, Code Scanning, and Copilot coding agent experienced delays. During this time, Actions workflow runs and job status updates were delayed by up to 25 minutes. Pages deployments dropped to about 4% of normal volume, webhook deliveries dropped to about 58% of normal volume, and Code Scanning analyses and Copilot coding agent sessions were delayed. Delayed events were processed after mitigation.

This incident was caused by a configuration change to an internal event-routing service that unexpectedly paused delivery of several event streams. The change depended on feature flags that were not set up as intended, which the service did not handle gracefully. We mitigated the first period by rolling back the configuration change at 16:14 UTC. The code change

result.answer:
Dựa trên dữ liệu từ các công cụ kiểm tra trạng thái (snapshot lúc 2026-11-09T03:50:47.065020+00:00 cho GitHub):

1. **GitHub Actions**:
   - **Trạng thái**: Tất cả các hệ thống hoạt động bình thường (`operational`), chỉ số `none`.
   - **Lịch sử**: Có ghi nhận một số sự cố gần đây liên quan đến Actions (ví dụ: các incident `h02n9572mx9y`, `xr3myzj7ms51`, `t89g2q1800fr` vào đầu tháng 11/2026), nhưng tất cả đều đã ở trạng thái **đã giải quyết (`resolved`)**.
   - **Nguồn**: [GitHub Status](https://www.githubstatus.com).

2. **Cloudflare Spectrum**:
   - **Trạng thái**: Việc kiểm tra trạng thái Cloudflare gặp lỗi Timeout (`TimeoutError`), dẫn đến kết quả chưa xác định do không truy cập được dữ liệu từ provider này. 
   - *Lưu ý quy tắc*: Không thể tự động kết luận là `operational` khi tool trả về lỗi timeout, do đó trạng thái hiện tại của Cloudflare Spectrum không thể xác nhận dựa trên bằng chứng thành công.
